name: Durability Watch
summary: Keeps an eye on how worn your equipped gear is and warns you in time, before an item breaks in the middle of a fight.
logoPrompt: A steel knight's helmet with a small crack and a few scratches, a glowing round gauge with a needle pointing to the red zone set in front of its lower edge
description: **Durability Watch shows the condition of your gear in percent and warns you before anything breaks, so you never find out at the worst moment.**
- A small display with your overall gear condition and the most worn item, in green, yellow or red.
- Mouse over it to see every damaged item with its slot.
- One warning on screen and in chat when an item drops to your warning level. The next one comes after a repair.
- At a vendor that can repair, one chat line tells you what a full repair costs.

It starts on its own. Drag the display where you like it. Type `/dw` to see the state and all commands. `/dw warn 30` sets the warning level, `/dw lock` locks the display, `/dw hide` and `/dw show` hide or show it.
- Works on Retail. It only reads the durability of your equipped items.
- It never repairs for you, it only tells you the price.
- The warning level starts at 25% and can be set from 5 to 90.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
